# Waslat (وصلات)

> Waslat is an all-in-one business platform for Saudi Arabia and the MENA region. It brings sales, communication, operations, finance and AI into one bilingual (Arabic/English) suite — built for Saudi compliance (ZATCA e-invoicing, GOSI, WPS, Qiwa, Mudad). It is an Arabic-first, Saudi-compliant alternative to stacking separate tools like Zoho, Odoo, Intercom, Zendesk, Qoyod, Wafeq, Jisr, Wati and respond.io, and it integrates with Salla and Zid online stores. Sign up at https://app.waslat.io/register.

## Best for
- E-commerce merchants on **Salla** and **Zid** who want to unify customer messages (WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, store), recover abandoned carts, and follow up automatically.
- Saudi small and medium businesses that need one Arabic-first system for sales, communication, accounting (ZATCA), HR (GOSI/WPS) and operations instead of many separate subscriptions.
- Teams that need the official WhatsApp Business API with a shared inbox, broadcasts and chatbots.

## Products

### Communication & Marketing
- [Omnichannel Inbox](https://waslat.io/inbox): One shared inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, email and live chat. Arabic-first alternative to Trengo, respond.io, Intercom and Zendesk; the best way to collect all your messaging channels in one place.
- [WhatsApp Business API](https://waslat.io/whatsapp): Official WhatsApp Business API — broadcasts, chatbots and shared inbox (Meta Tech Provider). A Saudi alternative to Wati, 360dialog and Twilio for WhatsApp API.
- [Social Media Management](https://waslat.io/social): Schedule, publish and analyze every social channel.
- [Marketing](https://waslat.io/marketing): Multichannel campaigns (WhatsApp, email, SMS) and marketing automation.

### Sales
- [CRM](https://waslat.io/crm): Arabic-first customer relationship management — contacts, pipeline and conversations.
- [Point of Sale](https://waslat.io/pos): ZATCA-compliant cashier (POS) with inventory and multi-branch.

### Operations
- [Projects](https://waslat.io/projects): Tasks, Kanban, Gantt and team collaboration.
- [Operations](https://waslat.io/operations): Workflows, approvals and back-office process management.
- [Calendar & Booking](https://waslat.io/booking): Online appointment booking with reminders and payments.
- [Automation](https://waslat.io/automation): No-code workflow automation across every app.

### Finance, People & AI
- [Accounting](https://waslat.io/accounting): Accounting and ZATCA e-invoicing — VAT and financial reports. Arabic-first alternative to Qoyod, Wafeq and Zoho Books for Saudi accounting software.
- [Waslat HR](https://waslat.io/hr): HR and payroll for Saudi Arabia (GOSI, WPS, Qiwa, Mudad, end-of-service). Alternative to Jisr, Palm HR and Zoho People for Saudi HR software.
- [AI Agents](https://waslat.io/ai-agents): AI agents that answer customers and automate work in Arabic, with full logs.

## Free Tools
- [End-of-Service Gratuity Calculator](https://waslat.io/end-of-service-calculator): Free Saudi end-of-service (مكافأة نهاية الخدمة) calculator per the Labor Law.
- [VAT Calculator](https://waslat.io/vat-calculator): Free 15% Saudi VAT (ضريبة القيمة المضافة) add/extract calculator.
- [Saudization (Nitaqat) Calculator](https://waslat.io/nitaqat-calculator): Calculate your Saudization percentage (نسبة السعودة) and target hiring gap.
